$schema_note: Design tokens of a webinar montage (template). Single source of truth: the Remotion project <job>/remotion imports <job>/style/tokens.json (baked into the bundle - re-bundle after edits); the EDL builder and ffmpeg scripts read the same rects. All geometry in px on the 1920x1080 canvas, all times in frames at 25 fps unless the key ends in _ms / _s. Values are those of the reference webinar (23.09.2026) so the scale is visible; brand, people, intro and outro are placeholders.

canvas.color: bt709 limited (tv); sources are tagged bt470bg -> convert 601->709 exactly once at ingest

hand.note: full OFL Caveat variable 400-700 (753 glyphs: Latin, Cyrillic, digits). The older fonts/Caveat-Regular.ttf is a 109-glyph subset WITHOUT lowercase Latin and digits — Latin fell back to a serif (caught on the chapter card 24.09). No '→' glyph: arrows come from the fallback font or are drawn.

mono.note: meta labels, timecodes, links; echoes the byline of the logo

studio.note: DEFAULT for clean slides / live sketch / P2 shares (tile cropped away): the whole slide is visible, camera sits on top of the chat column at native tile resolution (356x200 -> 368x207), chat below.

full.note: full-screen clean slide / deck video / P2 demo: nothing covers the content; no PiP (face returns with the next studio).

speaker.note: only when Zoom itself shows the full speaker view (P2 end, ~720p).

audio_only.note: Plaud-only minutes (no video): clean deck slide in main + portrait badge + 'аудио с диктофона' chip | design 24.09: + caption_band/lower_third_anchor/logo (Program reads them every frame)

studio_tile.note: ONLY for P1 Zoom-share feeds (floating camera tile burned into the top-right of the share): PiP flush over the burned tile so the face is shown once; chat gets the full column.
studio_tile.cam_mode: flush-top-right of main (covers the Zoom-burned tile)

full_tile.note: full-screen P1 Zoom-share demo: PiP flush over the burned tile.

board.note: ANIMATION AROUND THE SLIDE: slide shrinks to 60 % width and the stage margins carry hand-drawn arrows, labels, counters pointing INTO the slide. Only for 6-15 s beats, then back to studio.

intro_hidden.note: intro title card: the window waits invisible and small in the middle, then morphs into the teaser layout.

face.note: PUNCH-IN ON THE FACE at highlight moments (laugh, strong phrase, personal story): camera grows to 576x324 (1.6x of the native 356x200 tile, lanczos + light unsharp), slide shrinks but stays whole, chat widens under the camera. 4-8 s, then back to studio.

face_xl.lower_third_anchor_note: design 24.09 17:18: y 781 -> 803 so the name plate fully covers Zoom's burned-in name label at the bottom-left of the camera tile (it peeked out under the plate)
face_xl.note: HERO punch-in on the face (laugh, punchline, raffle reaction): camera and slide swap places in one morph; camera 1232x693 = 3.5x of the native 356x200 tile (soft, acceptable for 3-6 s, lanczos+unsharp at ingest). Use only on the strongest highlights; 'face' (1.6x) for ordinary emphasis.

source_crops_4k.note: Measured on 2 probe frames; the vision/timeline agent must confirm per segment (Zoom changes share mode). 4K = 3840x2160.
source_crops_4k.sidestrip_participant_names: x>=3504, y>=188 — NEVER show (private full names)

captions.engine: Remotion Captions2.tsx (architecture E, full-frame). The libass/ASS path of v1.2 is retired.
captions.size_note: ONE size (44 px) in every layout so text and pill move together through a morph

highlight.text_clip: navy text is a clip-path copy that follows the growing pill edge exactly (no colour jump)
highlight.never_pick: adverbs/fillers (буквально, наверное, пожалуйста, сразу, примерно...); prefer terms, numbers, tool names, conclusions

karaoke.note: upcoming words 42 % brightness, a word lights up over 3 frames from its spoken frame (w.s-1..w.s+2)

captions.drop_words: fillers э/ээ/мм; SURNAMES of private people (e.g. a raffle winner's surname spoken aloud) -> first name only

highlight.badge: «ВОПРОС ИЗ ЧАТА» only if the text contains «?»

chat.privacy: first name only; email/nick/unknown -> «Участник»; drop messages with emails, phones, links, @handles, surnames, company names of private people

question_toast_full.note: layout full only: the highlighted question being answered, chat-highlight style, spring in, holds while answered (<= 8 s)

vote_bubble.layout: name · «ответ» · answer chip (coral_soft bg, coral 800 20 px)

video_chip.style: coral pill like the PDF deck buttons «▶ Смотреть видео»: bg #F26941, text #010334 Manrope 800 20 px, radius 18, pad 8x16
video_chip.anchor: 24 px inside the top-left corner of the main window
video_chip.note: shown when a deck demo video starts; the clean source file replaces choppy Zoom playback (deck/assemble/assets_map.json rects). Not implemented yet.

art.what: live sketch of the chapter's key illustration (SketchArt, same engine) in the right half

chapter_card.audio_insert: source audio pauses for the 3.6 s card (insert); music bed pre-roll 1.2 s / post-roll 0.8 s

intro.teaser: 3 moments x 4-6 s, each in its own treatment (live sketch / board+hero / face), the real chat of those minutes, tag «ЛУЧШЕЕ ИЗ ЭФИРА»
title: <Заголовок, >
<акцент>
intro.subtitle: <подзаголовок эфира>
intro.note_fields: kicker/title[0]+title[1] (accent colour)/subtitle/host are drawn by components/Intro.tsx; underline_x1 = right end of the marker underline under the subtitle, rays_at = sparkle rays near the title end (tune to the text length)

outro.note_fields: QR PNGs are generated from URLs (scripts/webinar/deliver/make_qr.py); headline max 2 lines at 84 px - one line ran under the QR card in v1

audio.loudnorm: two-pass, linear=true, measured on the final mix
audio.dialog_chain: highpass=f=80, (afftdn only if noise floor > -55 dBFS), acompressor threshold=-20dB ratio=2.5 attack=15 release=250, per-part gain match before concat

music_bed.track: own track audio/music/bed.wav (e.g. ACE-Step 1.5, seed in the file name, ~75 s, ~-20.7 LUFS, no vocals); risers of the reference track were at 15.2/31.5/47.3/63.2 s -> put them on cuts; see style.example.md
music_bed.duck: volume envelope (not sidechain): -10 dB under voice, 0.35 s ramps

allowed: highlight chat bubble soft paper tick -38 dBFS

part_gain_db.source: measured per part by the align stage (ebur128 of each Zoom part vs the -16 LUFS recorder pieces) - values of the reference webinar

render_architecture.name: E: full-frame Remotion 'Program' composition driven by an EDL JSON (remotion/src/program/types.ts)
render_architecture.ingest: ffmpeg NVDEC/NVENC: 4K -> main clips 2560x1440 (601->709 once) + cam clips 640x360 from the 4K tile; clean slides from the PDF; art from deck/art
render_architecture.render: render_program.mjs: ONE node process per worker (bundle once, one browser), renderMedia h264 crf 16, jpeg 94; skip-if-exists per chunk; 5-min chunks cut at plan boundaries
render_architecture.parallel: several worker processes at once: measured 2 procs x c10 = 25.6-38.1 fps aggregate vs 21.3 fps single proc c16 (style.md §16); GPU only for ingest/concat
render_architecture.output: concat -c copy of chunks + separately mixed audio (mix_audio.py: loudnorm -16 LUFS, TP -1.5)
render_architecture.why_not_C_D: ffmpeg compositing (v1.2) was faster but could not carry live sketches, content-space marks, punch-ins with marks and reactions without simplification; the owner forbade simplification

encode.chunk: Remotion renderMedia h264 (libx264 crf 16, preset medium), yuv420p, bt709

layout_rules.lower_third_anchor: BOTTOM-LEFT point of the plate (inside the main feed, 24 px from its bottom-left corner)
layout_rules.cam_source: PiP pixels ALWAYS come from the 4K source crop (tile is 356x200 @4K = native camera res). Never from the 1080p proxy (tile there is ~178x100 -> 2x upscale = mush).
layout_rules.cam_cutout: PiP gets a 4 px stage-coloured ring on its inner (left/bottom) edges so it reads as a cut-out of the frame, outer corner radius = frame radius, inner corners radius 18.
layout_rules.burned_names: In side-strip share mode the participant list (x>=3504 @4K, y>=188) holds private full names: the main crop must end at x<3504. Never show it.
layout_rules.cam_slot: studio/board: camera on top of the chat column (clean slide fully visible); face: camera 576x324 punch-in; studio_tile/full_tile only for P1 Zoom-share feeds (PiP exactly over the burned tile). P2 shares cropped x<3440 (no tile, no names).
layout_rules.cam_grow: punch-in on the face: layout face (cam 1.6x, 4-8 s) for emphasis; face_xl (camera and slide swap, 3.5x, 3-6 s) only for the strongest highlights (punchline, laugh, raffle reaction). Morph 15-18 f in and out.
layout_rules.tags: tags/chips only where the content corner under them is empty; never over live UI (drum, demos)

$owner_directive: 24.09 14:40: «упрощение мне не нужно, нужно суперкрутое видео». No element is dropped for speed; speed comes from parallel chunks.

a_clean.what: clean slide render (PDF 1920x1080) instead of the blurry Zoom share, studio or full

b_live_sketch.engine: sketch-course-video trace.py -> sketch/NNN.json (per-element strokes, Gemini semantic boxes + cue words) -> SketchReveal.tsx (SVG mask strokeDashoffset reveals the ORIGINAL art)
b_live_sketch.beat: element start = frame of its cue word +-2
b_live_sketch.pen: visible marker on max 1-2 elements per slide
b_live_sketch.settle: 8-frame crossfade to the clean slide after the last element (+6 f)
b_live_sketch.when: first appearance of a slide explained point by point; never two live sketches back-to-back without a clean-slide pause

punch.rule: frame edges never slice a text line (top below the headline, bottom above the next caption)

arrow.rule: tip in content px of the slide; the path runs over empty stage/slide areas, never across slide text

d_around.text_rule: only what is said or written on the slide

treatments.choice: by meaning of the speech, not by timer: enumeration -> b; 'вот здесь'/number/conclusion -> c; metaphor/promise/link -> d; demo/long story -> a + face

poll.place: pinned at the top of the chat column under the header; the bubble list is pushed down by the card height
poll.kicker: mono 14 «● ОПРОС В ЧАТЕ · N отв.»
poll.sources: chat/chat_stats.json polls (16): pill K/S start+final, level 1/2/3, правда-или-ИИ A-F (reveal tick), фото-или-ИИ pairs, year 1956/1986/2012, plus-counters, rating 1-10 (average counts up)

reactions.source: chat/reactions_parsed.json (Zoom chat.txt, 127 events with target message); video_t = chat_msk - 23 s - part_t0
reactions.origin: bottom of the chat column (else under the cam, else the main window corner)
reactions.on_screen_zoom_reactions: NOT checked in the style task; the EDL builder scans frames (Gemini, 2 s step) and echoes them the same way

showcases.builder: EDL of 4 short showcases (intro, poll, chapter+video, event) cut from the full EDL by scripts/webinar/edl/make_tests.py

brand.note: public paths inside public_lite/ (brand/ folder of the job). mark = SVG path drawn as a stroke in the intro sting, then filled; w/h = its viewBox units. The example mark is the Vibe Academy 'V' with code brackets - replace with your own or set mark to null.
